effect_chunk_diagnostic.method: Identical ordered turf commands; reuse real retained-mixture fire_act probe. Compare original DM, one callback for the complete packet, and one callback per turf.
effect_chunk_diagnostic.result: Candidate split loses a write made through a previously issued mixture; this is not a tolerated float difference. Existing atomic path matches DM.
effect_chunk_diagnostic.proposed_fix: Retain the packet set of previously touched mixtures through completion, validate bindings and check final contents before the next calculation; no full-world scan. Preserve completed writes on errors.
effect_chunk_diagnostic.alternative: Retain an atomic compatibility path for packets with issued mixtures; less latency benefit.
effect_chunk_diagnostic.paradise: Saved Paradise SSair.process_bound_mixtures drains dirty bound mixtures in a separate budgeted phase before the next native tick. Banda direct list writes additionally require baseline comparison.

retained_mixture_fix.approved: Retain the set of touched mixtures until packet completion, including failure
implementation: Capture each outer callback working set
Final packet check validates owner, binding lifetime and mixture identity
ChangeTurf writes the accepted prefix before removing the old retained entry
Explicit mixture replacement and binding destruction remove old entries
Owner teardown checks retained writes before restoring DM air
Gas read APIs consult the retained working set
